name: Close all orders
summary: A utility EA that provides a GUI button to close all open market positions and/or delete all pending orders with a single click. It features a confirmation dialog, real-time order count display, and configurable slippage tolerance. The EA does not open any trades itself; it solely manages existing orders.
summary_zh: 一个工具类EA，通过图表按钮一键平仓所有市场头寸和/或删除所有挂单。具备确认对话框、实时订单计数显示和可配置的滑点容忍度。该EA本身不开仓，仅用于管理现有订单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个订单管理工具，因此没有传统意义上的入场或出场策略概念。其核心功能是批量平仓和批量删除挂单，用户通过点击图表按钮触发。仓位管理方面，EA遍历所有持仓和挂单，逆序逐一处理以避免索引错位。资金管理不涉及，因为EA不负责开仓或计算仓位大小。滑点参数允许用户控制平仓时的价格偏差容忍度。确认对话框功能增加了操作安全性，防止误触导致意外平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy EA but rather an order management utility, so it has no traditional entry or exit strategy concept. Its core function is batch closing of positions and batch deletion of pending orders, triggered by user clicking a chart button. For position management, the EA iterates through all positions and pending orders in reverse order to avoid index shifting during deletion. Money management is not applicable since the EA does not open positions or calculate lot sizes. The slippage parameter allows users to control price deviation tolerance when closing positions. The confirmation dialog adds operational safety by preventing accidental closures from misclicks.
pros: 一键平仓功能操作便捷，适合需要快速清仓的场景
确认对话框防止误操作，提升了操作安全性
逆序遍历订单避免索引错位，逻辑正确
实时显示市场订单和挂单数量，信息直观
可分别控制是否平仓市场订单或删除挂单，灵活性好
pros_en: One-click close all feature is convenient for scenarios requiring rapid liquidation
Confirmation dialog prevents accidental operations, improving operational safety
Reverse iteration over orders avoids index shifting issues, logic is correct
Real-time display of market and pending order counts provides intuitive information
Separate controls for closing market orders vs pending orders offers good flexibility
cons: 没有过滤功能，无法按品种、魔数或方向选择性平仓
没有重试机制，平仓失败后直接跳过不再尝试
每个tick都调用UpdateInfoDisplay和ChartRedraw，可能影响图表性能
没有填充模式(FILLING)设置，某些经纪商可能要求指定填充类型
INFO按钮功能较为简单，仅展示设置信息，实用性有限
cons_en: No filtering capability — cannot selectively close by symbol, magic number, or direction
No retry mechanism — failed closures are skipped without reattempting
UpdateInfoDisplay and ChartRedraw called every tick may impact chart performance
No filling mode (FILLING) specified, which some brokers may require
INFO button functionality is simple, only displaying settings with limited practical use
improvements: 增加按品种、魔数、方向过滤的功能，支持选择性平仓
添加平仓失败重试机制，提高在网络不稳定时的成功率
优化信息更新频率，使用定时器替代每tick刷新以减少性能开销
improvements_en: Add filtering by symbol, magic number, and direction for selective closing capability
Implement a retry mechanism for failed closures to improve success rate during unstable network conditions
Optimize info update frequency by using a timer instead of per-tick refresh to reduce performance overhead

risk_points: 每tick刷新图表可能在高频环境下影响性能
缺少填充模式设置在某些经纪商平台可能导致平仓失败
risk_points_en: Per-tick chart refresh may impact performance in high-frequency environments
Missing filling mode specification may cause closure failures on some broker platforms
